scenarios.title: Add
scenarios.assertion: Two uniquely named tasks appear after Enter.

scenarios.title: Edit
scenarios.assertion: Double-clicking and saving changes a task title.

scenarios.title: Complete and filter
scenarios.assertion: A completed task appears under Completed and is absent under Active.

scenarios.title: Persistence
scenarios.assertion: A task and its completion status remain after reload.

scenarios.title: Clear completed
scenarios.assertion: Clearing completed tasks removes only completed tasks.
